g1-implement.title: Gate 1 — trend measurement (B2 evidence gate (a)): implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch constellation-implementer. DELIVERABLE: .agent-work/issue-310/TRENDS.md, plus .agent-work/issue-310/trends/measure_surface.py and .agent-work/issue-310/trends/trends.json. THE INSTRUMENT MUST SUPPORT `--verify --data <json> --doc <md>`, which RE-DERIVES every figure from git, compares against the committed trends.json, asserts the skill enumeration count, asserts the two load bins are distinct keys, and asserts every headline number quoted in TRENDS.md is present in the dataset — exiting non-zero on any mismatch. This is the gate's closeout check and it was designed by FALSIFYING its predecessor: the original keyword-grep check was tested against a one-line decoy file containing only the keywords and the decoy PASSED, so the check was replaced. Do not weaken it back into a grep. THE CENTRAL OBLIGATION: .agent-work/archive/2026-08-02-issue-304/TREND_SNAPSHOT.md explicitly declares THIS run its successor ('at EPIC-298 CLOSE') and states what a successor must do — 're-run §1–§3 verbatim against its own HEAD, paste both numbers, and state the delta. A successor that reports only its own figures is a second baseline, not a trend.' So: re-run its commands VERBATIM first, for comparability, and only THEN add the wider always-loaded bin as a clearly-separated supplement. Changing the definition and reporting only the new one would break the series. Both bins (always-loaded = SKILL.md + the references/ SKILL.md names; conditionally-loaded = templates/, scripts/, unnamed references/) reported SEPARATELY per #393, with the arithmetic to recombine them published. Every number names the revision it was measured at. Do NOT rebuild #307's instruments; reuse them or state in writing why not. Wait for and integrate the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

preconditions.statement: e0-context complete; the #304 TREND_SNAPSHOT successor obligation is understood as binding, not optional

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers

g1-review.title: Gate 1 — trend measurement: review
g1-review.imperative: Fill templates/REVIEWER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch constellation-reviewer. The reviewer's PRIMARY job is to RE-RUN the instrument and confirm the numbers reproduce in its own hands — metadata about an artifact is not the artifact, and 'exit=0 plus a plausible elapsed time' is exactly what a fabricated table looks like. Second job: confirm the #304 TREND_SNAPSHOT §1–§3 commands were re-run VERBATIM and both numbers pasted with the delta stated, not silently replaced by a redefined metric. Third: confirm every enumeration asserts its count and every number names its revision. Wait for and integrate the returned REVIEW_RESULT.

g1-integrate.title: Gate 1 — trend measurement: integrate
g1-integrate.imperative: Check the REVIEW_RESULT verdict. APPROVE: re-run the verification command yourself before advancing. BLOCK: return for rework or raise a blocker. Log out-of-scope finds as triage candidates and harvest the result's Workflow Feedback into the lesson-candidate pool.

g2-competence.title: Gate 2 — role-competence evidence (B2 evidence gate (b)) [REASONING GATE]
g2-competence.imperative: REASONING GATE — no crew. Crew-waiver reason, stated per commander-core.md: the deliverable is a diagnosis over run artifacts this Commander already holds in context, and commander-core is explicit that a crew on a pure design note is shallower, not safer. Nothing here produces code or an independently-verifiable change; the g1 measurement, which does, carries the crew. DELIVERABLE: .agent-work/issue-310/COMPETENCE.md. STATE THE LIMITATION FIRST, in the opening paragraph, not a footnote: the controlled paired arm the spec asks for cannot be run, because testing kernel-plus-fragments requires a kernel-plus-fragments decomposition to exist and building it IS the break. Then assemble the OBSERVATIONAL evidence on Assumption 1 (run artifacts carry sufficient state) from the epic's own field record: the refresh / job-file-not-agent-file relaunch, where a FRESH agent cold-starts from `current` alone mid-spine with no handoff document. Enumerate every such instance found and ASSERT THE COUNT. Label every datapoint observational and uncontrolled; there is no monolith arm, so 'artifacts were sufficient here' is the strongest available claim and 'as correctly as one holding the monolith' is NOT. Report failed or ambiguous instances too — never quietly drop one. Attest c1.

g3-verdict.title: Gate 3 — the B2 evidence packet for Tommy [REASONING GATE]
g3-verdict.imperative: REASONING GATE — no crew. Crew-waiver reason: the deliverable is the decision packet itself, synthesised from g1 and g2, both already reviewed; a second crew read of a document whose inputs are already independently verified adds a reader, not a check. DELIVERABLE: .agent-work/issue-310/B2_GATE_EVIDENCE.md — the artifact Tommy reads. It MUST: (1) open with the limitations, not bury them; (2) say WHICH AXIS was measured — the commander is already split on the MODE axis (1e8043a/#107) and B2 proposes the CONTENT axis; refuse both the 'already satisfied' and the 'unstarted monolith' readings explicitly; (3) name which of exactly THREE outcomes the evidence selects — not-yet-earned / deletion-pressure-suffices / break-proceeds — and say plainly which, because an UNATTRIBUTABLE verdict is the one failure mode; (4) present the threshold sensitivity: since the confirmed spec never defines 'small enough' (its own critic S2 said so), state for each of the three outcomes what threshold would select it, and HAND THE THRESHOLD CHOICE TO TOMMY rather than picking one; (5) carry #307's two bounds intact — it measures PLACEMENT not DECOMPOSITION, and its manipulation was 8 days and +31 files, not #304 alone; (6) if and only if the evidence points at 'break proceeds', note that a human-readable whole-role projection is a REQUIRED view and the break gets its own cut. Do NOT rule. Attest c1.
